author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
The docs-regeneration cache key never tracked package source.

```yaml
key: docs-regen-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('packages/*/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}', 'docs/scripts/**/*.ts', 'docs/typedoc.json') }}
```

`hashFiles` uses `@actions/glob`, which does not support brace expansion. Running the real package against this repo:

| Pattern | Files matched |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/*/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}` | **0** |
| explicit per-extension patterns | **45** |

So the key only ever reflected `docs/scripts/**` and `docs/typedoc.json`.

This is the same hazard #1798 fixed in this file's `on.push.paths` block. The comment that fix left behind is still there:

```yaml
# Note: GitHub Actions path filters do not support brace expansion
# (e.g. `*.{ts,tsx}`), so each extension is listed as its own pattern.
```

The path filters were corrected; the cache key three sections down was not.

## Observable effect

Three separate commits that each modified `packages/*/src/**/*.ts` produced an identical cache key:

| Run | Commit | Files under `packages/*/src/` | Key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 34038835477 | `a3947ca0` | 1 | `docs-regen-Linux-75fd6cd1…` |
| 34039565992 | `0d2c7912` | 2 | `docs-regen-Linux-75fd6cd1…` |
| 34052091514 | `5d7d15fb` | 2 | `docs-regen-Linux-75fd6cd1…` |
| 34060270681 | `7a20340f` | 3 | `docs-regen-Linux-0f58363f…` |

The last differs only because that commit also touched `docs/scripts/*.ts`, which is matched by a brace-free pattern.

## Scope — what this does and does not explain

This fixes a real defect: the cache key is now correct, and package source changes will invalidate it.

It is **not** established that this alone unfreezes generated documentation. The evidence is incomplete in a way worth stating rather than papering over. [description truncated to fit budget]
title: fix(ci): correct docs-regen cache key that never tracked package source
